summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing, pursuant to its buy-back announced 5 August 2026, the 18 September 2026 repurchase for cancellation of 3,000,000 ordinary shares (US$0.50) on UK venues at a volume-weighted average price of £15.1716 and 400,400 ordinary shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at HK$162.4208, executed through BNP Paribas Financial Markets SNC. Since the programme commenced, 39,608,897 shares, approximately US$815.0m, have been repurchased. No board recommendation or advisor beyond the broker is named; mechanics are on-exchange UK and on-market Hong Kong purchases.
